template.description: Footage-first quote edit with centered inverted word captions, correctable native-time word layers and original audio. Clean render uses generated stand-ins, not recorded speech.
template.fixture: Generated color-motion source and sine tone demonstrate layout, not real quote or transcription quality.
template.editorialIntent: Keep the full picture; one flat bold uppercase hit at a time in the center, clearing gaps after 750ms. Difference blending inverts the footage beneath the text; no card or headline. Select the caption stream before using simultaneous speakers.
template.review: Word layers bind exact source and immutable baseline IDs at initialization.
template.wordInput: Each input entry is a timed word or intentional short phrase. Original text and word intervals remain immutable; caption display clips to next entry or 750ms. No word-level timing is inferred.
